trello.name: Set up Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Define three subscription tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) in Stripe as per specified pricing and feature sets. Integrate these tiers into the app ensuring they reflect correctly in terms of functionality and user experience.

trello.name: Frontend Development: Stripe Elements Integration
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe Elements for the checkout process on the app. Ensure the form is customizable, secure, and matches the app's design. Handle potential errors like invalid card details or insufficient funds gracefully.

trello.name: Update Pricing Page
trello.desc: Revise the pricing page to reflect new subscription tiers. Include a clear comparison of features for each tier and ensure the checkout button is prominent. Add tooltips or help icons to explain plan changes.

trello.name: User Dashboard Functionalities
trello.desc:
Develop functionalities on the user dashboard to include:
- Current plan details and billing info
- Options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription
- Access to invoices and payment history
- Method for updating payment methods
Ensure real-time reflection of subscription status and notifications of changes such as plan upgrades or payment failures.

trello.name: Backend Development: Stripe API Integration
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe's API to manage subscription-related tasks on the backend. This includes creating and managing subscriptions, processing payments, and handling webhooks for events.

trello.name: Webhook Event Listeners
trello.desc:
Set up backend handlers for the following webhook events:
- invoice.payment_succeeded
- invoice.payment_failed
- customer.subscription.deleted
Develop these webhook handlers to ensure system updates and user notifications as required.

trello.name: Testing Plan
trello.desc: Prepare and execute a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests. Simulate different event scenarios (e.g., payment failures, cancellations) to test the entire subscription flow from sign-up to billing and management.

trello.name: Frontend-Backend Integration
trello.desc: Coordinate integration between frontend and backend. Ensure real-time update of subscription changes on the dashboard. Handle errors during integration with clear user notifications.

trello.name: Documentation and User Support
trello.desc: Develop user documentation and support materials. This should include instructions on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and troubleshooting common issues. Ensure clarity and user-friendly presentation.

trello.name: API and Webhook Documentation
trello.desc: Document all API endpoints and webhook event handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting purposes. Ensure the documentation is thorough and accessible for future reference.
